steps.title: The optical path
steps.text: The graph shows the light from the source, through the sample and the optics, to the detectors. Drag nodes to move them, drag from a pin to connect, scroll to zoom, right-click for the component menu.

steps.title: Add a component
steps.text: Click a component in the list, then press Add to Graph. It appears in the middle of the visible graph. Double-clicking a row does the same.

steps.title: Start from the standard path
steps.text: Reset to Default replaces the graph with the standard two-colour path. Press it to follow the rest of the tour on a complete path.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.text: Calculate Emission Intensity propagates the spectra through the graph. The tables below fill with the detected signals and the crosstalk matrices.

steps.title: Read the results
steps.text: Signals lists the detected intensity per laser line, detector and dye. Excitation, Emission and Detected are the crosstalk matrices; Förster radius lists R0 per donor and acceptor.

steps.title: Easy Mode
steps.text: The Easy Mode tab edits the same path as a form: lasers, dichroic, dyes and detectors. Its changes update the graph.

steps.title: Keep your work
steps.text: Save Graph writes the graph to a JSON file; Save Preset keeps it as an Easy Mode preset; Save to MMFDB stores the simulation.

steps.title: More help
steps.text: The Help button explains the components, the simulation and the files in detail.
